reference.authors: Changhao Li, Seigo Kikura, Akihisa Goban, Hayata Yamasaki, and Shinichi Sunami
reference.title: Operational criteria for quantum advantage in latency-constrained nonlocal games

notes: Each replicate simulates one Table III channel with an independent PCG64 stream.
An attempt occupies one memory from launch through tau_e + tau_link + tau_dec + tau_res, regardless of herald outcome, matching the deterministic Li Equation 46 assumption.
The emitter is work-conserving and waits for the earliest memory release when the finite bank is full.
Bell-pair outcomes are independent Bernoulli samples with the Equation 56 success probability.
The warmup interval exceeds the time needed to fill the memory bank and is excluded from all reported rates and occupancy moments.
